none: PAS FindID 984926: Siliqua of the House of Theodosius

A silver clipped siliqua of the House of Theodosius (possibly of Magnus Maximus, AD 383-88), probably dating to c. AD 383-88 (Reece Period 20), VIRTVS ROMANORVM, Roma seated facing. Mint of Milan. The obverse has been double stamped, reading MDP near the emperor's face. Obverse description: Pearl-diademed, draped and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: Garbled from double stamp. Reverse description: Roma seated front, head left, holding globe & reversed spear. Reverse inscription: VIRTVS [ROMAN]ORVM. Diameter: 13.49 mm, thickness: 0.79 mm, weight: 0.78g
